errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the yellow sector represents 'никога' (never), while it actually represents 'по-малко от 10' (less than 10) at 26.2%; the sector 'никога' (never) is represented by the grey color, not yellow.
The description states that the sector 'между 10 и 20' occupies approximately 11.9% and '20 или повече' occupies approximately 4.8%, which are incorrect; these sectors visually appear larger.
The description fails to mention that the sector '20 или повече' (20 or more) corresponds to the blue color and its percentage is missing entirely.
The phrase 'визуално заема' (visually occupies) is vague and could be stated more clearly regarding the proportions shown in the pie chart.
